purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign081, before opening any Campaign082 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The normalized distance between the largest intrabar log-range time and the largest amount time measures whether the day's strongest price-discovery shock and strongest participation shock co-arrive, rather than their levels, recencies, full-profile correlation, distributional similarity, entropy, or path smoothness.
Range-peak recency alone is too close to volatility resolution, extreme-arrival timing, and the existing peak-amount-recency family.
A signed lag creates two post-shock narratives and an avoidable direction search; the selected absolute timing alignment has one frozen higher direction.
Choosing k, a percentile threshold, or a prominence rule creates an unnecessary parameter family and a rescue path.
Distribution-wide amount/price-discovery similarity is already represented by Campaign053 and would be a field variant of that terminal mechanism.
A full-grid contemporaneous association would re-express terminal range-volume confirmation and amount-volatility coupling rather than isolate extreme-event co-arrival.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_range_amount_peak_timing_alignment_240m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When the session's widest one-minute price-discovery interval coincides with its largest participation burst, repricing is supported by concentrated liquidity and attention rather than occurring in a thin isolated interval; that coordinated shock may persist over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: For exact standard bars i=0..239, set r_i=log(high_i/low_i). Let i_range be the last index attaining max(r_i) and i_amount the last index attaining max(amount_i). Return 1-abs(i_range-i_amount)/239.
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 in collapsed observation order 0..239. The 09:30 row is source identity only and excluded. No return or transition is formed across lunch.
selected_candidate.tie_rule: Use the last exact occurrence of the maximum independently for log range and amount; do not add a tolerance, prominence rule, or first-occurrence alternative.
selected_candidate.source_semantics: All 240 high and low values must be finite and strictly positive with low<=high. All 240 amounts must be finite and nonnegative. Require max(log(high/low))>0 and max(amount)>0; otherwise the score is missing.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 high/low/amount bars; no future session, daily return, comparator, or Candidate49 observation is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
